info.name: Lists all Kubernetes clusters in the project and returns their details.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project that owns the clusters.

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: Filters results to the cluster with this ID.

params.name: cluster_name
params.description: Filters results to the cluster with this name.

params.name: cluster_search_names
params.description: Filters results to clusters whose name matches one of these search names.

params.name: locations
params.description: Filters results to clusters in these locations.

params.name: states
params.description: Filters results to clusters in these states.

params.name: versions
params.description: Filters results to clusters running these versions.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort results by; prefix with '-' for descending order.

params.name: show_inactive
params.description: Whether to include inactive clusters in the results.

params.name: next_token
params.description: Base64-encoded token for the next page of results.

params.name: prev_token
params.description: Base64-encoded token for the previous page of results.
